title: 7-Day Phuket Fairways, Beach Clubs & Nightlife Tour
description: Championship golf by day, world-class beach clubs by night. Play Laguna Golf Phuket, Red Mountain, and Blue Canyon.

signatureTour.title: Thailand Royal Siam
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our premier 10-day signature tour combining Phuket’s coastal tracks with Bangkok’s VIP nightlife and dining.

inclusions.detail: Dedicated executive party vans on standby for all course transfers and evening nightlife outings.
3 rounds: Laguna Golf Phuket, Red Mountain, and Blue Canyon.
6 nights in Luxury Beachfront Suites on Bang Tao Bay.
Curated access and VIP reservations at premier beach clubs including Catch and Cafe del Mar.
On-ground assistance with late tee sheets and evening reservations.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuket & Catch Beach Club Sunset Welcome
itinerary.subtitle: Island Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Banyan Tree Phuket — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Banyan Tree Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Phuket and meet your private executive driver for transfer to Bang Tao Beach. Check into your luxury suite and get ready for an exciting week.

Head down to Catch Beach Club for welcome sunset drinks, fresh oysters, and chilled beats right on the sand.

itinerary.title: Resort Parkland Strategy at Laguna Golf Phuket
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Island Parkland
itinerary.imageCaption: Laguna Golf Phuket — Paul Jansen / Max Wexler (Par 71, 6,606 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Laguna Golf Phuket championship golf course Paul Jansen / Max Wexler Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Laguna Golf Phuket. The forgiving fairways and scenic water hazards provide the perfect opening round to shake off travel rust.

Spend the afternoon relaxing on Bang Tao beach before an evening exploring the vibrant craft cocktail bars and dining spots in Cherngtalay.

itinerary.title: Adrenaline Golf at Red Mountain Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Extreme Elevation & Drama
itinerary.imageCaption: Red Mountain Golf Club — Johnathan Morrow / Al Tikkanen (Par 72, 7,002 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Red Mountain Golf Club championship golf course Johnathan Morrow / Al Tikkanen Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on the dramatic cliffs and jungle canyons of Red Mountain Golf Club, navigating stunning elevation drops and breathtaking island vistas.

Celebrate with post-round beers on the patio before heading into Old Phuket Town for craft beers, live acoustic sets, and southern Thai food.

itinerary.title: Beach Club Day of Rest & Island Speedboat Charter
itinerary.subtitle: Rest & Beach Club Vibes
itinerary.imageCaption: Banyan Tree Phuket — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Banyan Tree Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Sleep in and recharge with a lazy brunch on Bang Tao beach. Spend the afternoon lounging at a premier beach club or charter an optional private speedboat out to the Phi Phi islands.

Enjoy an evening barbecue feast on the beach with sunset cocktails and music.

itinerary.title: Championship Test at Blue Canyon Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Championship Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Blue Canyon Country Club — Yoshikazu Kato (Par 72 (Canyon), 7,165 Yards (Canyon))
itinerary.imageAlt: Blue Canyon Country Club championship golf course Yoshikazu Kato Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Conclude your golf rotation at Blue Canyon Country Club, testing your skills against one of Asia’s most celebrated championship tracks.

Head to Cafe del Mar for a high-energy sunset session, enjoying world-class DJs, cocktails, and beachfront dancing.

itinerary.title: Recovery Pool Day & Farewell Seafood Dinner
itinerary.subtitle: Island Relaxation
itinerary.imageCaption: Banyan Tree Phuket — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Banyan Tree Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A relaxed final day to swim, catch the sun, and enjoy restorative massages after a full week of golf and nightlife.

Gather for a grand farewell dinner at a cliffside restaurant overlooking the Andaman Sea, toasting an unforgettable trip.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Phuket International Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Banyan Tree Phuket — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Banyan Tree Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before packing your clubs with assistance from your AGS host.

Your private executive transfer delivers you to Phuket Airport for your return flight home.

faqs.question: Can tee times be scheduled later in the morning?
faqs.answer: Yes, for nightlife groups we frequently schedule 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM tee times to allow ample recovery from the previous evening.
